art_direction.style: Original friendly 2D educational Shorts avatar; clean flat vector/cartoon illustration, rounded shapes, expressive eyes, simple soft shading, bold readable silhouette, bright but balanced colors.
art_direction.reference_policy: Use the user's reference only as a high-level description of the broad cartoon style. Never upload, attach, feed, trace, copy, recreate, or otherwise use the reference screenshot/image as an input asset for any agent or video-generation model. All four avatars below are original designs created from written descriptions.
art_direction.branding_policy: Do not show, mention, draw, imitate, or hint at the logo, symbol, mascot, brand mark, or corporate identity of Claude, OpenAI, ChatGPT, Codex, OpenCode, GLM, or any AI provider. Characters must look like independent fictional presenters, not representatives of the AI tools that create them. No logos, badges, patches, emblems, branded clothing, or recognizable provider symbols.
art_direction.consistency: Each agent must use only its assigned character. Keep face, hairstyle, outfit, palette, proportions, and generic non-branded accessory consistent across that agent's videos. Characters must be independently drawn/animated; do not reuse the same base character with only a recolored hoodie.
art_direction.animation: Use simple 2D motions such as blinking, mouth movement, pointing, nodding, hand gestures, and small body movement.
